name: Sargon of Akkad
why: Built the first empire known to history, uniting the cities of Mesopotamia.

name: Hammurabi
why: United Mesopotamia and issued one of the oldest written law codes.

name: Ramesses II
why: The New Kingdom's greatest builder and warrior pharaoh, who fought the Hittites at Kadesh.

name: Cyrus the Great
why: Created the largest empire the world had yet seen and freed the exiled Jews of Babylon.

name: Pericles
why: Led Athens in its golden age of democracy and built the Parthenon.

name: Alexander the Great
why: Conquered the Persian Empire from Egypt to India and spread Greek culture across it.

name: Ashoka
why: Ruled almost all of India and spread Buddhism after renouncing war.

name: Qin Shi Huang
why: Unified China, standardised its script and coins, and began the Great Wall.

name: Emperor Wu of Han
why: Doubled China's size, opened the Silk Road and made Confucianism state doctrine.

name: Julius Caesar
why: Conquered Gaul and ended the Roman Republic.

name: Cleopatra
why: Last ruler of Ptolemaic Egypt, allied with Caesar and Mark Antony.

name: Augustus
why: Founded the Roman Empire and two centuries of Pax Romana.

name: Marcus Aurelius
why: The philosopher emperor, last of the Five Good Emperors.

name: Constantine the Great
why: First Christian emperor; founded Constantinople.

name: Attila
why: Led the Hunnic Empire against both halves of the Roman world.

name: Justinian I
why: Reconquered Italy and North Africa, codified Roman law and built Hagia Sophia.

name: Emperor Taizong of Tang
why: Built Tang China into the strongest state in Asia.

name: Charlemagne
why: United most of western Europe and was crowned emperor in 800.

name: William the Conqueror
why: Conquered England in 1066 and remade its ruling class.

name: Saladin
why: United Egypt and Syria and retook Jerusalem from the crusaders in 1187.

name: Genghis Khan
why: United the Mongols and began the largest land empire in history.

name: Kublai Khan
why: Conquered Song China and ruled the Mongol world from Beijing.

name: Mansa Musa
why: Ruled the richest empire of medieval Africa; his gold-laden pilgrimage became legendary.

name: Timur
why: Conquered from Anatolia to Delhi in the last great steppe conquest.

name: Yongle Emperor
why: Built the Forbidden City and sent Zheng He's fleets to Africa.

name: Pachacuti
why: Turned Cusco into the Inca Empire and built Machu Picchu.

name: Mehmed II
why: Conquered Constantinople in 1453.

name: Isabella I of Castile
why: With Ferdinand united Spain, took Granada and sponsored Columbus.

name: Charles V
role: Holy Roman Emperor, King of Spain
why: Ruled Spain, the Netherlands, Austria and the Americas at once.

name: Suleiman the Magnificent
why: Took the Ottoman Empire to its height, besieging Vienna in 1529.

name: Akbar
why: Built the Mughal Empire across north India with religious tolerance.

name: Elizabeth I
why: Defeated the Spanish Armada and presided over England's golden age.

name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
why: Unified Japan and founded 250 years of Tokugawa peace.

name: Louis XIV
why: The Sun King made France Europe's dominant power and built Versailles.

name: Kangxi Emperor
why: China's longest reigning emperor, who secured Qing rule over a vast empire.

name: Peter the Great
why: Westernised Russia, built St Petersburg and made it a European great power.

name: Frederick the Great
why: Made Prussia a great power in the Seven Years' War.

name: Catherine the Great
why: Expanded Russia to the Black Sea and into Poland.

name: George Washington
why: Led the American Revolution and became the first president.

name: Napoleon
why: Conquered most of Europe and spread the Napoleonic Code.

name: Simon Bolivar
why: Freed Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia from Spain.

name: Queen Victoria
why: Reigned over the British Empire at its height.
polities: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

name: Abraham Lincoln
why: Led the Union through the Civil War and ended slavery.

name: Otto von Bismarck
why: Unified Germany through three wars and dominated European diplomacy.

name: Emperor Meiji
why: Japan's Meiji Restoration turned it into a modern industrial power.

name: Vladimir Lenin
why: Led the Bolshevik Revolution and founded the first communist state.

name: Mustafa Kemal Ataturk
why: Built a secular Turkish republic from the Ottoman ruins.

name: Joseph Stalin
why: Industrialised the USSR by terror and led it to victory over Nazi Germany.

name: Adolf Hitler
why: Started the Second World War in Europe and perpetrated the Holocaust.

name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
why: Led America through the Depression and the Second World War.

name: Winston Churchill
why: Led Britain's resistance to Nazi Germany.
polities: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

name: Mahatma Gandhi
why: Led India's non-violent struggle for independence.

name: Mao Zedong
role: Founder of the People's Republic of China
why: Won the Chinese Civil War and ruled communist China.

name: Deng Xiaoping
why: Opened China's economy and began its rise to superpower.

name: Mikhail Gorbachev
why: His reforms ended the Cold War and led to the Soviet Union's breakup.

name: Nelson Mandela
why: Ended apartheid peacefully and became South Africa's first Black president.
